description:
Configure Minimum Advertised Price (MAP) settings for the store. 

1. Enable MAP globally in Stores > Configuration > Sales > Sales > Minimum Advertised Price. Set the 'Default Explanation Message' to: 'Add to cart to see our special low price!'

2. Configure the product 'Business Laptop Pro' (SKU: LAPTOP-001) to hide its price on the storefront. Edit the product, open Advanced Pricing, set the 'Manufacturer's Suggested Retail Price' to 1200.00, and set 'Display Actual Price' to 'In Cart'. 

Save all configurations and the product. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.

metadata.expected_message: Add to cart to see our special low price!
